title: Lantern Lane
tagline: Wander the golden-hour village, gather the lost lanterns, and light the big lantern tree.
pitch: Lantern Lane: a cozy evening village collect-a-thon. Wander a warm little town at golden hour as a cat, gather lost lanterns and letters for the neighbours, chat with friendly villagers, and light the big lantern tree in the plaza. Soft acoustic music, a cozy rounded HUD, no rush.

plan.title: Lantern Lane
plan.tagline: Wander the golden-hour village, gather the lost lanterns, and light the big lantern tree.
plan.core_loop: Wander a warm golden-hour town as a cat, hopping over fences and benches, collecting lost lanterns scattered along the lanes and chatting with friendly villagers, then carrying the light back to the big lantern tree in the plaza.
plan.win_condition: Collect 18 lanterns and reach the big lantern tree in the plaza to light it.
plan.lose_condition: None — no timer, no enemies, unlimited lives; the dusk waits as long as you need.
plan.art_direction: Warm honey-and-peach palette at golden hour: chunky, rounded low-poly houses with thatched roofs, wooden stalls and fences, cobblestone lanes, and glowing amber lanterns that pop against the first blue of dusk. Soft long shadows, gentle bloom on every light, storybook warmth in the spirit of Animal Crossing dusk and Ghibli village scenes. The mood is unhurried and safe — every corner feels like home.
concept_shots: The ginger cat trots down a cobblestone lane at golden hour past a bakery stall and a mailbox with a letter, amber lanterns bobbing on fence posts, long warm shadows stretching across the lane.
The plaza at dusk: the big lantern tree heavy with glowing lanterns, the cat standing beneath it as the last light blooms and warm confetti drifts down.
A rooftop moment: the cat perches on a thatched roof as the follow camera shows the village glowing below, sky gradient peach to dusk blue with puffy honey clouds.

assets.sky: Golden hour panorama: low honey sun, peach and amber gradient fading to soft dusk blue at the top, puffy warm clouds, a few distant birds

features: Villager greetings: friendly NPCs at stalls and doorsteps pop UI.dialog speech bubbles when the cat gets close
Lantern tree that fills up: the plaza tree's lights bloom as the counter climbs, with a full FX.sparkles + confetti burst when it lights
Cozy HUD: rounded lantern counter with the generated lantern icon, an objective line, and a warm 'The tree glows!' banner on win
Pickup juice: warm FX.burst, floating '+1' text and a soft bell chime on every lantern
Golden-hour ambience: warm fog and gentle bloom on every lantern light, drifting dust motes in the sunbeams
Gentle win moment: slow-mo, confetti of warm light, and the big lantern tree glowing against the dusk sky

result.summary: Lantern Lane is a cozy golden-hour village collect-a-thon built on the town level. The ginger cat (orange body, teal accent) wanders a warm honey-and-peach village with a low sun for long shadows, a peach-to-dusk-blue sky, warm fog and gentle bloom. The player gathers 18 glowing lantern orbs scattered along the lanes (24 placed, off-route bonuses included) and then reaches the big lantern tree in the plaza to light it. Features: a lantern tree at the goal that gains brighter/wider warm sparkles as the counter climbs; four villager NPCs (Mira the Baker, Old Bram, Postman Pip, Sage) placed beside the route who pop cozy speech-bubble dialogs and make the cat wave when approached; pickup juice with a warm amber burst + floating '+1' on every lantern; a gentle win moment with slow-mo, warm confetti, a flash, a star burst on the tree, a 'The tree glows!' banner and the win screen; generated lantern-post and mailbox voxel props along the lanes; cozy-styled HUD with a lantern counter (18 target), minimap and objective line; title screen selling the fantasy; generated sky, music and sfx. No timer, no enemies, no lives — the dusk waits as long as you need. Autopilot confirmed the player moves along the route and collects lanterns with zero console errors.
changes: Tuned the cozy look to golden hour: honey/peach palette (warm ground, roofs, glow), low sun (elevation 14), peach-to-dusk sky, warm fog, gentle bloom
Recolored the player to the plan (orange body, teal accent, cream skin)
Recolored the HUD to cozy style with a lantern counter (18 target), minimap and objective line
Added the big lantern tree at the plaza goal with idle warm sparkles that grow brighter/wider as lanterns are collected
Added four villager NPCs beside the route with cozy dialog speech bubbles and a cat wave emote when the player gets close
Added pickup juice: warm amber FX.burst + floating '+1' text on every lantern
Added a gentle win moment: slow-mo, warm confetti, white flash, star burst on the tree, 'The tree glows!' banner, and a win-screen title/sub
Kept generated voxel props (lantern posts, mailboxes) beside the route and the generated sky/music/sfx
known_issues: The lantern orbs use the kit's default orb glow (purple-blue) rather than a custom amber color, since the kit exposes no per-collectible color option for the 'orb' tag
The HUD counter icon uses the built-in orb icon; the generated lantern icon did not render in the counter slot (showed a fallback star), so the built-in icon is used instead
